name: 悟空传奇
detailed_description:
Do you crave a moment of mental relaxation and challenge in the fast-paced life? Now, simply download 'The Legend of Wukong' and embark on a wonderful journey full of joy and wisdom. ​

1、 Download benefits

Massive question bank: Once downloaded, you will immediately have a rich treasure trove of brain teasers, covering multiple fields such as life, humor, logic, etc. You can always get fresh and interesting questions anytime and anywhere, keeping your thinking active at all times. ​

Daily Surprise: Log in to the game every day and receive mysterious rewards, which may be tip props to help you easily solve problems when stuck; It could also be a fun avatar frame that showcases your unique personality. ​

Offline Play: No need for internet connection, as long as the download is completed, you can enjoy the fun of gaming anytime, anywhere. When queuing, taking a bus, or resting, you can give your brain a "sharp turn". ​

2、 Game background

In a mysterious kingdom of wisdom, ancient sages created countless wonderful brain teasers and puzzles to test and enhance people's thinking abilities. These puzzles are scattered in every corner of the kingdom, waiting for brave explorers to come and challenge them. You, as a curious adventurer, have entered this kingdom of wisdom, determined to solve all puzzles and become a symbol of wisdom. ​

3、 Game functions

Concise interface: The game adopts a minimalist design, with simple and easy to understand operation, making it easy for both children and elders to quickly get started. Clear topic presentation, accompanied by vivid and interesting illustrations, makes every brain teaser come to mind. ​

Difficulty grading: The difficulty of the questions gradually increases from a simple introductory level to a challenging level that requires deep thinking. Based on your answer situation, intelligently adjust the difficulty of subsequent questions, ensuring that beginners can easily experience it while also providing enough challenges for experts. ​

Tip and Help: Don't worry when you encounter difficulties! The game provides multiple ways of prompts to help you broaden your thinking; At the same time, it is also possible to easily seek help from WeChat friends, share fun, overcome difficulties together, and increase social interaction. ​

Score record: Detailed record of your answer history, accuracy rate, and answer time, making it convenient for you to review your own thinking growth process. You can also compete with friends to see who is the real "brain teaser master".
